**What I found:** The invoice PDF formatter belongs in `src/exports` next to the billing export job, and it should not import `src/orders/repository.js` (the record calls this PLACE). That planned import skips `src/orders/index.js`, which is the only entry point the orders code offers, and the existing caller `src/exports/billing-export.js:1` already goes through `index.js`.

**Why it matters:** If the formatter imports `repository.js` directly, it depends on how orders are stored, and the order rules in `index.js` (the 21% tax at `src/orders/index.js:6`) can end up copied into the formatter and drift apart. Nothing would catch this, because the repo has no import rules.

**Do this first:**
1. Create `src/exports/invoice-pdf.js` as a function that takes data and returns a PDF. `runBillingExport` gets order data through `getOrderTotals` and passes it in. The formatter makes no `src/orders` import at all.
2. If the PDF needs order lines as well as totals, add one read function to `src/orders/index.js` and leave `repository.js` private.
3. When you add the PDF library, import it only in `invoice-pdf.js`.

**What I did not check:** 
- Which fields the PDF needs. Settle this against the invoice spec before step 2.
- Which PDF library to use. There are no dependencies in `package.json` yet.
- Lint enforcement. There's no ESLint or architecture config, so no rule ran. Run `/alchemy E` to add one.

```
Dispatch:   DIRECT
Core route: L
Companions: None
Execution:  single-agent — one placement, three static edges
```

| Subsystem / edge | Declared position | Observed pressure | Finding | Evidence / confidence | Decision | Next action | Verification |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| invoice-pdf → `src/orders/repository.js` (planned) | billing-export / capability / consumer → orders / primitive / infrastructure | Not measured | cross-domain coupling (skips `orders/index.js`); also a layer skip from consumer to infrastructure | `repository.js` exports storage access only; `index.js` is the de facto entry point, used by `billing-export.js:1`; high | Drop the edge | Get order data through `orders/index.js`, passed in by `runBillingExport` | Search: `src/exports` has no import of `orders/repository` |
| `src/orders` inbound interface | orders | Not measured | Not declared: `index.js` is the entry point only by convention; `package.json` has no `exports` field and there are no rules | Read of all 3 source files; high | Declare it | E handoff below | Lint rule once E runs |

                     Allowed neighbors: billing-export (caller); orders only via src/orders/index.js, reached through the caller
Position legality:   Pass for the placed design; Fail for the planned edge: cross-domain coupling + layer skip, invoice-pdf → orders/repository.js
Observed fields:     Not measured — Rapid, static edges only
Static cycle:        Pass — exports → orders/index → orders/repository, acyclic

Enforcement:         add architecture rule: src/** outside src/orders/** must not import src/orders/** except src/orders/index.js (warn → error)
